name: tinydrop
title: Tinydrop
description: Search, open and save Raindrop.io bookmarks from an offline store. No wait on the network.
author: mimukit

commands.name: search-bookmarks
commands.title: Search Bookmarks
commands.subtitle: Raindrop
commands.description: Search the offline bookmark store, open a bookmark, and run row actions.

commands.name: add-bookmark
commands.title: Add Bookmark
commands.subtitle: Raindrop
commands.description: Save a bookmark with a form. The URL comes from the clipboard.

commands.name: clean-up-bookmarks
commands.title: Clean Up Bookmarks
commands.subtitle: Raindrop
commands.description: Find duplicate and dead links, then move them to Raindrop Trash.

commands.name: sync
commands.title: Sync
commands.subtitle: Raindrop
commands.description: Pull the changes from Raindrop into the offline store.

preferences.name: refreshOnOpen
preferences.title: Refresh on open
preferences.label: Sync when the store is stale
preferences.description: Run a sync when Search Bookmarks opens and the last sync is older than the age below.

preferences.name: refreshAge
preferences.title: Stale after
preferences.description: The age at which Refresh on open runs a sync.
